get.description:
Server-Sent Events: the agents' turn summaries as they are written.

Frames:
- `sessions`: every agent session; sent first and on each change.
- `event`: one turn summary; its `id:` is the resume cursor.
- `status`: the investigation's status, on open and on each change.
- `end`: the run finished and every event was sent. The `sessions` frame before it carries the run's cost,
  `null` until the charge is recorded.
- `access_lost`: you can no longer see the investigation.

The stream closes after about five minutes; reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` or `after` to resume. Comment lines
keep the connection open.

graph.title: Graph
graph.description: `scout` only. If true, runs Scout as an Atlas investigation, billed per unit of research. It enables the Atlas run options (`max_credits`, `max_minutes`, `relentless`, `investigation_id`, `investigation_name`, `include_workspace`), makes `struct` optional, and the async response returns the `investigation`. Requires Scout in Atlas for your organization. If false or omitted, Scout runs as usual.

include_workspace.title: Include Workspace
include_workspace.description: Atlas runs only. If true, includes the investigation's workspace files in the result; they are read from the investigation, so they include later runs' changes. Default: true.

investigation_id.title: Investigation Id
investigation_id.description: Atlas runs only: continues this investigation, reusing its graph and workspace, instead of creating one. Default: creates one.

investigation_name.title: Investigation Name
investigation_name.description: Atlas runs only: the title of a new investigation. Ignored with `investigation_id`. Default: taken from `lead_info`.

private.title: Private
private.description: If true, shows the run's result, status and usage log only to you (with an API key, to the key's creator). Your team must allow private runs. Atlas runs need the async endpoint and a new investigation.

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: Your team's connected APIs the run's agents may call, by name. Leave it out to allow all of them; an empty list allows none. Taken by `xhigh`, by `scout` with `graph`, and by `high`; refused on other tiers.

relentless.title: Relentless
relentless.description: Atlas runs with `struct` only. If true, researches until the budget runs out. If false, a run may stop once every requested field is answered, and is charged for the research it used (at least one unit). Default: false.

agent_trace.title: Agent Trace
agent_trace.description: Atlas runs only. If true, the investigation's Agents tab in Atlas shows a short, readable summary of each agent's reasoning and actions as it works. The trace is for people reading along: it does not change the research or the results. Leave it off when you only read results through the API. Default: false.

generate_report.title: Generate Report
generate_report.description: Atlas runs only. If true, starts the investigation's PDF intelligence report when research completes. You can also generate one at any time with `POST /investigations/{investigation_id}/report` or from the Report tab in Atlas. Default: false.

max_credits.title: Max Credits
max_credits.description: Atlas runs only: research budget in credits, from one to 10 units of the tier price. Default: one unit. The whole budget is used and charged unless the run stops early (see `relentless` and `max_minutes`).

max_minutes.title: Max Minutes
max_minutes.description: Atlas runs only: the most minutes of research time; waiting to retry does not count. When reached, the run writes up its findings, which can take a few minutes, and is charged only for the research it used. Default: no limit.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Skills the run's agents follow, by name: `team/<name>` for one of your team's skills, `sixtyfour/<name>` for one of ours. Up to 25,000 tokens in total. Taken by `xhigh`, by `scout` with `graph`, and by `high`; refused on other tiers.

private.description: If true, shows the run's result, status and usage log only to you (with an API key, to the key's creator). Your team must allow private runs. Atlas runs need the async endpoint and a new investigation.

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: Your team's connected APIs the run's agents may call, by name. Leave it out to allow all of them; an empty list allows none. Taken by `xhigh`, by `scout` with `graph`, and by `high`; refused on other tiers.

relentless.title: Relentless
relentless.description: Atlas runs with `struct` only. If true, researches until the budget runs out. If false, a run may stop once every requested field is answered, and is charged for the research it used (at least one unit). Default: false.

agent_trace.title: Agent Trace
agent_trace.description: Atlas runs only. If true, the investigation's Agents tab in Atlas shows a short, readable summary of each agent's reasoning and actions as it works. The trace is for people reading along: it does not change the research or the results. Leave it off when you only read results through the API. Default: false.

generate_report.title: Generate Report
generate_report.description: Atlas runs only. If true, starts the investigation's PDF intelligence report when research completes. You can also generate one at any time with `POST /investigations/{investigation_id}/report` or from the Report tab in Atlas. Default: false.

max_credits.title: Max Credits
max_credits.description: Atlas runs only: research budget in credits, from one to 10 units of the tier price. Default: one unit. The whole budget is used and charged unless the run stops early (see `relentless` and `max_minutes`).

max_minutes.title: Max Minutes
max_minutes.description: Atlas runs only: the most minutes of research time; waiting to retry does not count. When reached, the run writes up its findings, which can take a few minutes, and is charged only for the research it used. Default: no limit.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Skills the run's agents follow, by name: `team/<name>` for one of your team's skills, `sixtyfour/<name>` for one of ours. Up to 25,000 tokens in total. Taken by `xhigh`, by `scout` with `graph`, and by `high`; refused on other tiers.

exclusive_run.title: Exclusive Run
exclusive_run.description: Atlas runs on an existing investigation only. If true, returns 409 while that investigation has a run starting or running, instead of starting and charging a second one. Default: false.

score.title: Score
score.description: 0-100; higher is more likely to be delivered.

status.title: Status
status.description: The run's current status. After an accepted cancellation it can read `running` until the run stops.

cancellation_requested.title: Cancellation Requested
cancellation_requested.description: True when the stop request was accepted; the run can take a moment to reach its final status. False when the run had already ended.
